title: Georgia wildfires satellite images reveal destruction — Newsweek
snippet: Satellite images captured by Landsat 8 show charred forests and residential areas. Hwy 82 Fire 22,471ac 75% contained, Pineland Road Fire 32,575ac 44% contained as of May 4. False color imagery shows burned areas gray, vegetated green, and active fire fronts orange.
